bullets.text: Raised $1.1B via $600M 30-year senior debt (4.20%) and $500M preferred stock (5.375%); paid $296M to increase ARX ownership to 86.7%; portfolio lost 0.3%, trimming $350M of equities.
Personal auto PIF grew 14% and Property 30%; reached 12M auto PIFs, adding 1M in eight months; crossed 25M Personal Lines vehicles insured; auto PLE is more than halfway to goal.
Companywide NPW grew 23% YOY to open 2018; total new home and condo applications rose nearly 60% compared to Q1 2017; direct Commercial Lines generated over 25% new application growth.
First-quarter combined ratio was sub-90, setting the company up nicely for the year and heading into hail season, continuing momentum carried over from a remarkable 2017.
Quarterly media spend was the highest in company history, generating record Direct auto sales at a cost per sale significantly below target; ASI home products rebranded as "Progressive Home."

HomeQuote Explorer bundled quoting pilot reached over 25% of countrywide volume; Smart Haul UBI launched for Motor Carriers with 2% penetration; commercial auto and claims services for Uber subsidiaries expanded to three additional states.

Snapshot mobile app represented over 60% of eligible Direct UBI selections, collecting 600M miles; deployed Customer Relationship Assistant models and new web servicing environment; lowered UBI tech expenses partly through mobile penetration.
Auto product model 8.5 debuted in Iowa, offering more competitive rates to customer segments with longer-term, stable prior insurance histories, with rollouts planned for additional states.

Direct Commercial Lines new applications grew over 25% year-over-year; exceeded 1M direct small business insurance shoppers in 2017; Smart Haul UBI saw slow agent adoption, high conversion, and planned Q2 direct rollout.
Chairman Glenn Renwick will retire after May Annual Shareholders Meeting following 30+ years; over 200 customer-story contest winners participated in Opening Day ceremonies at Progressive Field.
